about.title: {language}, **katono buli lunaku.**
about.intro: {app} musomo gwa bwereere eri buli ayagala okwogera {language}. {description} Amasomo amampi agafaanana ng’emizannyo gakutwala okuva ku kulamusa okutuuka ku kunyumya okwa buli lunaku ku b’omu maka, emmere, akatale, okutambula, obulamu n’ebirala.
about.how: Buli kitundu kireeta ebigambo n’ebigambo ebigatte bitono, n’oluvannyuma ne bibyegezesebwamu mu ngeri nnyingi: okulonda ebifaananyi, okuzimba sentensi, okuwuliriza, okuwandiika n’okugatta. Ebigambo ebikuzibuwalira bikomawo okwejjukanya mu kiseera ekituufu, era engero zikusobozesa okusoma wamu n’abantu b’omusomo. Ennaku ez’omuddiriŋŋanwa, XP n’ekiruubirirwa kya buli lunaku bikuyamba okugenda mu maaso.
about.account: Tewali kye weewandiisa. Enkulaakulana yo eterekebwa ku kyuma kyo, era app ekola nga tolina yintaneti bw’emala okutikka. Osobola okuggyayo enkulaakulana yo mu [Entegeka](#/settings) ogiterekere oba ogitwale ku kyuma ekirala.
about.ads: Amasomo ga bwereere. Okusasula ebisale by’okugiddukanya, ebirango bitono ebiraga bulungi nti birango biyinza okulabika wakati w’emitendera gy’ekkubo n’oluvannyuma lw’essomo, so si wakati mu ssomo. Laba [ebikwata ku byama](#/privacy) okumanya ebirango bwe bikola.
about.open: App ezimbibwa mu lwatu ku [GitHub]({repo}). Okutereeza {language} kwaniriziddwa bulijjo.

contact.title: Tulamuse **ggwe.**
contact.intro: Olabye ensobi mu ssomo, olina ekirowoozo, oba ekibuuzo ku app oba ebirango byayo? Twagala nnyo okuwulira okuva gy’oli.
contact.email: Tuwandiikire ku [{email}](mailto:{email}). Ebiseera ebisinga tuddamu mu nnaku ntono.
contact.issues: Osobola n’okuggulawo [ensonga ku GitHub]({issues}). Bw’oba otereeza olulimi, teekamu ekitundu ne sentensi tusobole okugisanga amangu.
contact.progress: Tetusobola kulaba nkulaakulana yo, kale bw’oba obuuza ku yo, nnyonnyola ekyabaddewo mu bubaka bwo.

terms.title: Obukwakkulizo bw’**okukozesa.**
terms.intro: Bw’okozesa {app} okkiriza obukwakkulizo buno. Bw’oba tobukkiriza, tokozesa app.
terms.use: {app} ya bwereere eri okuyiga okw’omuntu ku bubwe. Togezaako kutaataaganya mukutu, kuguggyako ne gugufuula gugwo, wadde okunyiga ku birango mu bugenderevu okubyongeza.
terms.data: Enkulaakulana yo ebeera mu browser yo. Bw’osangula ebiri mu browser, oba n’okozesa ekyuma oba browser endala, otandika buggya okuggyako ng’oggyeeyo n’oyingiza enkulaakulana yo. Tetusobola kukuzzaayo nkulaakulana ebuze. Laba [ebikwata ku byama](#/privacy) okumanya ebisingawo.
terms.ads: App eyinza okulaga ebirango okuva mu Google AdSense, bulijjo nga biwandiikiddwako nti Kirango. Ebintu n’obuweereza mu birango biva eri ababirangirira, so si gye tuli, era tetubiwagira.
terms.content: Tufuba nnyo okukuuma okuvvuunula nga kutuufu, naye ennimi zaawukana mu boogezi ne mu bitundu, era ensobi zibaawo. Omusomo guweebwa nga bwe guli, awatali bweyamo bwonna. Koodi ya app efulumizibwa ku [GitHub]({repo}).
terms.changes: Tuyinza okukyusa app n’obukwakkulizo buno. Obukwakkulizo bwe bukyuka, n’olunaku waggulu lukyuka. Olina ekibuuzo? [Tukwatagane](#/contact).

privacy.title: Ebikukwatako **bisigala naawe.**
privacy.keep: {app} terina akawunti wadde seva yaayo. Erinnya lyo, ekifaananyi kyo, enkulaakulana, ennaku ez’omuddiriŋŋanwa, XP n’entegeka biterekebwa mu browser yo ku kyuma kino. Tetubiraba n’akatono. Osobola okubiggyayo, okubiyingiza oba okubisangula essaawa yonna mu [Entegeka](#/settings).
privacy.adsOn: {app} ya bwereere era ewagirwa ebirango okuva mu Google AdSense.
privacy.adsOff: {app} eyinza okulaga ebirango okuva mu Google AdSense okusigala nga ya bwereere.
privacy.adsWhere: Ebirango birabika mu bifo bitono byokka, nga wakati w’emitendera gy’ekkubo ly’okuyiga ne ku muko ogulaga nti essomo liwedde, era bulijjo biwandiikiddwako nti **Kirango**. Tebirabika mu ssomo, mu kwegezaamu wadde mu lugero.
privacy.cookies: Google ne banne bakozesa cookies okulaga ebirango. Bw’olonda _Kkiriza_, Google eyinza okukozesa cookies okukulaga ebirango okusinziira ku mikutu gy’okyalirako. Bw’olonda _Ebirango ebya bulijjo byokka_, Google ekulaga ebirango ebitali bya ggwe wekka, wadde nga eyinza okukozesa cookies okukomya emirundi ekirango gye kirabika n’okuziyiza obukumpanya. Osobola okukyusa ky’olonze mu [Entegeka](#/settings) essaawa yonna.
privacy.google: Manya ebisingawo ku [Google bw’ekozesa ebiva ku mikutu egikozesa obuweereza bwayo](https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites), era ofuge ebirango ebikukwatako ku [Google Ads Settings](https://adssettings.google.com).
privacy.offline: Bw’oba tolina yintaneti, tewali kirango kitikkibwa.
privacy.pixelOn: Tukozesa Meta Pixel okulaba oba ebirango byaffe ku Facebook ne Instagram bireeta abayizi abaggya.
privacy.pixelOff: Tuyinza okukozesa Meta Pixel okulaba oba ebirango byaffe ku Facebook ne Instagram bireeta abayizi abaggya.
privacy.pixel: Etikkibwa wokka bw’olonda _Kkiriza_ ku kaadi ya Facebook oba mu [Entegeka](#/settings). Bw’eba ekkiriziddwa, Meta efuna emiko gy’oggulawo, bw’omaliriza okutegeka, bw’omaliriza essomo (ekika kyalyo ne XP) n’ennaku ez’omuddiriŋŋanwa ezituukiddwako, wamu ne browser yo by’etera okuweereza, nga IP address yo ne cookies za Meta. Erinnya lyo, ekifaananyi kyo, by’oddamu n’enkulaakulana yo tebiweerezebwa n’akatono. Londa _Nedda, weebale_, oba ogiggyeko mu Entegeka, tewali kirala kigenda eri Meta.
privacy.meta: Manya ebisingawo mu [ebikwata ku byama bya Meta](https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy).
privacy.fonts: Ebiwandiiko bikozesa ennukuta eziva mu Google Fonts, kale browser yo ezisaba okuva eri Google omulundi ogusooka bw’okyalira. Oluvannyuma ziterekebwa ku kyuma kyo.
privacy.weather: Bw’oteekako _Embeera y’obudde ku ngaali_ mu [Entegeka](#/settings), browser yo ekubuuza w’oli omulundi gumu. Kirongoosebwa okutuuka nga km 10, kikuumibwa ku kyuma kino, era kiweerezebwa eri [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com) omulundi gumu gwokka buli ssaawa okumanya embeera y’obudde ey’ewammwe. Open-Meteo teyetaaga akawunti era tekozesa cookies. Kiba kiggaddwa okutuusa ng’okiteeseeko.
privacy.children: Tetukuŋŋaanya mu bugenderevu bikwata ku muntu yenna. Olw’okuba ebirango bisobola okukukwatako bw’okkiriza wokka, abazadde basobola okulonda _Ebirango ebya bulijjo byokka_ ku bayizi abato.
privacy.changes: Ebikwata ku byama bino bwe bikyuka, n’olunaku waggulu lukyuka. Olina ekibuuzo? [Tukwatagane](#/contact).
